propositions: The review-bot container must authenticate to Bedrock using the instance role rebar-gerrit-instance-role via IMDS, not static API keys.
The instance role lacks bedrock:InvokeModel and bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream permissions scoped to Claude foundation models and cross-region inference profiles.
The IAM grant must be scoped to anthropic.claude-* models and *.anthropic.claude-* inference profiles (with region wildcarded) to authorize the Converse API calls rebar makes through pydantic-ai.
IMDS reachability from the review-bot container is the precondition; if unreachable, http_put_response_hop_limit must be raised to 2 in metadata_options, with the exception documented in ADR 0046.
The new policy must be added to a separate iam_s7.tf file to preserve the single-owner contract on iam.tf (established by iam_s2.tf and iam_s4a.tf pattern).
Real Converse calls from the instance prove which IAM action is authorized; policy simulation alone is insufficient and can mislead if performed under a wildcard-holding identity.
